purpose: Native CSD renderer coverage audit across every CSD project the runtime loads. Cross-references three pre-existing reports (loader parity, all-screens render, asset binding) and classifies the 8.8% of skipped draw commands so we know which are legitimate vs which would be real renderer gaps.

phase_291_sanity_cap_skips.rule: renderer skips a single-cast scene whose post-base-scale destination size exceeds 4x the canvas (sgfx_hud_native_csd_renderer.hpp:544)
phase_291_sanity_cap_skips.what_these_are: container scenes that span 'all of asset space' by design (e.g. cts_stage_select, cts_choices_bg in ui_worldmap; unleash_bg, life_bg in ui_playscreen_ev). The container's *children* render via OTHER scenes; rendering the container as a single quad would draw a giant background slab over everything.

text_rendering_not_implemented.what_these_are: scenes whose content is text (help-screen captions, world-map help body text). The native CSD renderer does not implement font/text rendering yet -- CSD ships separate font tables that get composited by the runtime, not the static asset.
text_rendering_not_implemented.verdict: known gap -- needs a follow-up phase to implement CSD font rendering

actionable_gaps.what: Native CSD renderer does not implement font/text rendering
actionable_gaps.evidence: 10 zero-drawn scenes (help_chara_1/2/3, help_text_area x7). All have 1x1 normalized bounds and 1 draw command that renders nothing.
actionable_gaps.scope_of_impact: ui_help screen looks like an empty frame; ui_worldmap_help body text doesn't appear
actionable_gaps.what_unblocks_it: Implement CSD font glyph rendering (SDDFTBL font tables in the asset) -- separate phase

actionable_gaps.what: ui_start splash screen multi-language variants partially skip
actionable_gaps.evidence: ui_start renders at 61.5%; the per-language headline panels are stacked and only one shows at a time, but the renderer doesn't pick a single language
actionable_gaps.what_unblocks_it: Add a language selector to the renderer (host picks JP/EN/etc, renderer skips the others). Low priority -- doesn't affect any in-scope screen except the loading-start splash.
